function.name: list_workspace_items
function.description: List workspace items only when a fresh or filtered inventory is needed. Do not list input scope before reading or searching: the [WORKSPACE INPUTS] context already provides complete current input IDs. memory includes stale entries and current content hashes; temp includes only temporary attachments scoped to this run.

kinds.description: For input scope, optional item kinds to include.

function.name: manage_workspace_memory
function.description: Create, refresh, patch, rename, or delete agent-maintained workspace memory. Table memory is materialized from sandboxed Python; text memory stores Markdown and supports hash-guarded exact patches.

memory_id.description: Required for refresh, patch, rename, and delete.

kind.description: Required for save; inferred from the existing memory for refresh.

name.description: Required for save and rename; optional for refresh.

description.description: Required for save; optional for refresh.

id.description: Stable ID listed by list_workspace_items with input scope.

locator.description: Optional source location used, such as {"page": 2}.

input_sources.description: Required for table save/refresh. Optional provenance for text memory.

code.description: Required for table save/refresh; Python code producing the DataFrame to remember.

output_variable.description: Required for table save/refresh; DataFrame variable produced by code.

content.description: Required for text save/refresh; complete Markdown content.

expected_content_hash.description: Required for patch; current hash from list_workspace_items with memory scope.

new_text.description: Replacement text; empty deletes the match.

replacements.description: For patch, ordered exact replacements. Ambiguous matches fail unless replace_all is true.

append_text.description: For patch, optional text appended after replacements.

function.name: read_workspace_item
function.description: Read bounded normalized content from a workspace input. Data accepts a row locator and columns option; normalized text accepts a line locator. Temporary items with python-only capability should be read through execute_python_script using their path.

item_id.description: Stable input item ID from list_workspace_items.

locator.description: Optional canonical location: {"row": 1} for data or {"line": 1} for normalized text.

options.description: Optional semantic adapter options; library-specific arguments are not accepted.

function.name: search_workspace_items
function.description: Search readable current input items. Returns stable item IDs, canonical locators, and bounded matching text. Stale memory and python-only temporary items are not searched.

item_ids.description: Optional stable item IDs to search.

options.description: Optional semantic adapter options; library-specific arguments are not accepted.
